evals.prompt: Run JTBD research on invoicing tools for UK freelance designers. I want real quotes I can use on our landing page.
evals.expected_output: Checks for .agents/product-marketing.md then .claude/product-marketing.md. Searches Reddit, review sites, and forums, fetching actual threads. Produces a report with evidence window, job statements in 'When I, I want to, so I can' format, ranked pains in customer words, loves and complaints per tool, switching triggers mapped to push, pull, anxiety, and habit, a verbatim quote bank with URLs, and a confidence and gaps section.
assertions: Checks .agents/product-marketing.md before .claude/product-marketing.md
States the evidence date range at the top of the report
Job statements use the 'When I ___, I want to ___, so I can ___' format
Every quote in the quote bank has a source URL
Switching triggers are grouped into push, pull, anxiety, and habit
Includes a section flagging thin or weak evidence
Does not include usernames of posters

evals.prompt: Do voice-of-customer research for our product. Context file is in .agents/product-marketing.md.
evals.expected_output: Reads the context file and takes the product, audience, and competitors from it without re-asking. Runs the research. Because the context file has a JTBD section, proposes additions or corrections to it with current and suggested text side by side, and asks before writing.
assertions: Reads the context file and does not ask for information already in it
Uses competitors named in the context file as research targets
Proposes changes to the context file's JTBD section showing current and suggested text
Asks for confirmation before editing the context file
Does not overwrite the context file silently

evals.prompt: I've got eight customer interview transcripts from people who switched to us from spreadsheets. Can you pull out the jobs and switching triggers, and combine it with what people say online?
evals.expected_output: Codes the transcripts and the online sources with the same lens, labels first-party quotes as such, maps switching evidence to the four forces, and notes where interview findings and public evidence agree or differ. Removes customer names from quotes.
assertions: Labels quotes from transcripts as first-party
Maps switching evidence to push, pull, anxiety, and habit
Compares interview findings with public evidence
Removes or avoids customer names in the quote bank
Counts independent sources rather than individual posts

evals.expected_output: No problem space given. If no context file exists, asks for the problem space (and up to five questions in total) before searching, and suggests running gtm-context without blocking.
assertions: Asks for the problem space before doing any research
Asks no more than five questions
Suggests the gtm-context skill if no context file is found
Does not invent quotes or pains
